I, myself, copy vocal records as much as I copy instrumental records. And I still will copy a vocal record because of the phrasing and the feeling, the breath control, that kind of thing. And I don't think, in the case of a wind player, that you should limit yourself to jazz players. If you hear a good opera singer, just for phrasing -- I'm talking about a technical point of view, just for phrasing and breath control, listen to a good opera singer or a good popular singer. I have all of Nat Cole's records, I copy…

I think people should listen to good blues singers a great deal. If you want to be a jazz player and you don't have a feeling for good blues singers, I think you may as well forget it because you're not going to be a jazz player in the sense that I know what jazz is. So then you've got another branch because just a few inches behind blues singers is the good gospel singing.
